Questions?

Frequently asked questions

What does Sanctify.biz do?
Sanctify is Goa's award-winning digital marketing agency. We help businesses across Goa grow with Web Design, SEO, Google Ads, Social Media, Graphic Design, Content Marketing, Email & SMS, Local Listings.
Which areas of Goa do you serve?
We serve businesses across North and South Goa, including Panjim, Mapusa, Calangute, Baga, Candolim, Anjuna, Vagator, Porvorim, Margao, Vasco da Gama, Colva, Benaulim, Ponda, Palolem, Morjim.
How much do your services cost?
Pricing depends on your needs. Web design starts from ₹14,999 and SEO from ₹9,999. Get a free custom quote.
